display.name: Envoy Gateway Dashboard
display.description: Envoy Gateway Metrics

display.name: namespace
display.description: Infrastructure namespace filter

spec.queryValue: SELECT DISTINCT(JSONExtractString(labels, 'namespace')) FROM signoz_metrics.time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name IN ('resource_apply_total', 'resource_delete_total') AND JSONExtractString(labels, 'namespace') != ''

display.name: runner
display.description: Watch runner filter

spec.queryValue: SELECT DISTINCT(JSONExtractString(labels, 'runner')) FROM signoz_metrics.time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name = 'watchable_subscribe_total' AND JSONExtractString(labels, 'runner') != ''

display.name: controller
display.description: Controller-runtime controller filter

spec.queryValue: SELECT DISTINCT(JSONExtractString(labels, 'controller')) FROM signoz_metrics.time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name = 'controller_runtime_reconcile_total' AND JSONExtractString(labels, 'controller') != ''
